note: MC_Olodo's spinning hook kick. Frames 0-2 wind up, 3-5 turn away and coil, 6 is the EXTENSION (the leg is horizontal at head height — this is the frame that connects), 7-11 spin down and recover, and 12-31 are a near-identical standing guard tail that the game does not play. This sheet faces LEFT (cap peak, shades and beard point left in every guard frame) — the same way as the EMOTE stance and OPPOSITE to SpecialMove. The BOSS.hook / BOSS.hookSuper tables in game.js are the authoritative frame order.
